# lumos_accounts (Data Source)

Accounts in the organization's apps. Requires `app_id` or `email`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "app_id" {
  type = string
}

# A user's accounts in one app, found by email.
data "lumos_accounts" "alice" {
  app_id = var.app_id
  email  = "alice@example.com"
}

output "alice_account_ids" {
  value = [for a in data.lumos_accounts.alice.accounts : a.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Filter to accounts on this app.
- `discovered_after` (String) Filter to accounts whose `discovered_at` is at or after this time.
- `discovered_before` (String) Filter to accounts whose `discovered_at` is at or before this time.
- `email` (String) Filter to accounts whose email (as reported by the app) matches this value; matching is case-insensitive, per the database collation. Note: the unversioned GET /accounts silently ignores this parameter; only /v1 filters by it.
- `sources` (List of String) Filter to accounts discovered by these sources.
- `status` (List of String) Filter to accounts in these lifecycle statuses.

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) Accounts returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `account_type` (String) The type of this account: `user`, `role` (e.g. AWS), or `service` (e.g. GCP).
- `app` (Attributes) The account's app. Present only with `expand=app`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts--app))
- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app that owns this account.
- `discovered_at` (String) The time that Lumos first discovered this account, in ISO 8601 format.
- `email` (String) The email of this account.
- `id` (String) The ID of this account.
- `last_activity` (String) The last time a user completed an action tracked by Lumos, in ISO 8601 format.
- `last_login` (String) The last time a user logged into this app, in ISO 8601 format.
- `sources` (List of String) The discovery methods through which Lumos identified this account.
- `status` (String) The status of the account.
- `unique_identifier` (String) The stable identifier of this account from the associated service.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user associated with this account.

<a id="nestedatt--accounts--app"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts.app`

Read-Only:

- `app_class_id` (String) The catalog identifier of the underlying app (e.g. "github.com"). Custom apps return "custom".
- `category` (String) The category this app belongs to.
- `description` (String) A description of the app.
- `disconnected` (Boolean) Whether this app has been disconnected (its stored credentials removed via `POST /v1/apps/{app_uuid}:disconnect`). A disconnected app is excluded from `GET /v1/apps?disconnected=false`; reconnect it by sending credentials to `PATCH /v1/apps/{app_uuid}`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the app.
- `instance_id` (String) The app-instance identifier distinguishing multiple instances of the same app.
- `label` (String) The display name of the app.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the app logo image.
- `status` (String) The lifecycle status of this app. One of `discovered`, `in-review`, `needs-review`, `approved`, `blocklisted`, `deprecated`.
- `website_url` (String) URL of the app's official website.
